title: Inpatient Hospice Acute-Use Medications
rule_summary: Massachusetts inpatient hospices may use pharmacy-owned ADD stock in approved Schedule II-VI categories as a limited acute palliative bridge until the full patient prescription can be filled and delivered, subject to registration, monitoring, reconciliation, packaging, and bed-capacity quantity controls.
exam_relevance: Tests a distinct pharmacist decision path using current official authority rather than rote trivia.
